description: Verification outcome of each document in the order of the entitlement verification rules (typ, alg, kid in the root-verified manifest with purpose entitlement, signature, schema and claims, instance and subject, iat/nbf, seq), with the inputs of context.json. A verifier that checks the closed schema first may answer a code from also_acceptable.

invalid/tampered-kid.jws.reason: the header names another trusted entitlement key; the signature was made by the first

invalid/wrong-subject.jws.reason: a link document where the instance document is expected

invalid/iat-future.jws.reason: issued more than 300 s in the future

invalid/nbf-future.jws.reason: not valid before more than 300 s in the future

invalid/unknown-kid.jws.reason: a key id the manifest does not list

invalid/wrong-purpose.jws.reason: signed by a key whose purpose is not entitlement

invalid/stale-seq.jws.reason: a lower sequence number than the cached document (cached seq 3)
